title: voxel-builder criteria checklist
description: Schema for criteria.json — the scope-indexed SSOT the orchestrator dispatches from. Validate with: wpdev elementor:lint is unrelated; use any draft-07 validator.

severity.description: Row-level gate-blocking CEILING (consumed by the §2g computed gate), not the per-finding severity. A criterion's protocol may emit findings at any level at or below this ceiling at runtime; 'C/I' = can block at Critical or Improvement depending on must/should classification.
